integration.description: Connect GitHub with a personal access token for repositories and sync.

pat.label: Personal Access Token
pat.instructions: Create a personal access token in GitHub and paste it below. Use Fine-grained tokens or classic tokens with the repository scopes you need.

connect.instructions: Create a personal access token in GitHub and paste it below. Open Fine-grained tokens or classic tokens, generate a token with the repository scopes you need, then save the connection.

github.section-description: Connect GitHub for source control and sync.
github.connection-description: Use a personal access token to authorize repository access at tenant level.
